upload.acceptFormat: Supports JPG, PNG, BMP and other common image formats, single file

face.title: Face Recognition
face.description: Detect face position and liveness in images, and analyze attributes and emotion. Models are configured under Settings → Face Recognition.

ocr.title: OCR Text Recognition
ocr.description: Recognize all text blocks in an image and merge them into full text. Detector / recognizer / direction / restorer models are configured under Settings → OCR.

recognition.title: Image Recognition
recognition.description: Run image classification, object detection and captioning, plus super-resolution enhancement. Capabilities are configured under Settings → Image Recognition; unconfigured ones are skipped.
recognition.caption: Caption
recognition.srNotEnabled: Super-resolution is disabled: configure an enhancer model and enable the switch under Settings → Image Recognition
recognition.noCapability: No results: no usable model is configured under Settings → Image Recognition. Configure a classification / detection / captioning model and retry

layout.title: Layout Detection
layout.description: Detect text / table / image layout regions in documents, and parse them into Markdown. The layout model is configured under Settings → Layout Recognition.
